edge.reason: corpus consumes foundation-frozen contracts: ServerContext, defaultPdfRoot, primitives. Per splits.xml/@depends-on.
ingest tools require an active corpus (NO_ACTIVE_CORPUS guard); corpus.activate must land first. Per splits.xml/@depends-on.
extraction tools (pdf.refresh-extraction, papers.search) require an active corpus. Per splits.xml/@depends-on.
annotations.* tools guard NO_ACTIVE_CORPUS; corpus.activate must precede. Per splits.xml/@depends-on.
UI dispatch wires scholar.ingest.* commands; nu module exposes ingest verbs. Per splits.xml/@depends-on.
PaperDetail consumes scholar.paper.show + scholar.digest.show; ReaderProgress consumes scholar.progress.show. Per splits.xml/@depends-on.
UI annotation surface depends on annotations.* tools landing first. Per splits.xml/@depends-on.
build-plugin.ts step 2 bundles src/ui/; UI artifact must exist before packaging. Per splits.xml/@depends-on.

invariant.constraint: All nine tool-module stubs (corpus, roots, snapshot, ingest, pdf, papers, digest, prompts, annotations) plus raw-ddl.ts, primitives.ts, and ollama/client.ts exist as foundation-scaffolded files before any wave-2+ teammate dispatches.

enforcement.gate: test -f src/server/tools/corpus.ts && test -f src/server/tools/roots.ts && test -f src/server/tools/snapshot.ts && test -f src/server/tools/ingest.ts && test -f src/server/tools/pdf.ts && test -f src/server/tools/papers.ts && test -f src/server/tools/digest.ts && test -f src/server/tools/prompts.ts && test -f src/server/tools/annotations.ts && test -f src/server/db/raw-ddl.ts && test -f src/server/ingest/primitives.ts && test -f src/server/ollama/client.ts

invariant.constraint: Foundation is the sole writer of package.json and bun.lock per spec §6.1 (S4-pinned). No commit on wave 2+ may modify either file.

enforcement.gate: FOUNDATION_TIP=$(git log --format=%H --reverse --grep='cycle 6.1' -- package.json | head -1); test -n "$FOUNDATION_TIP" && { git diff "$FOUNDATION_TIP"..HEAD -- package.json bun.lock | grep -q . && exit 1 || exit 0; } || exit 0

invariant.constraint: Every registerTool call site uses a name beginning with 'scholar.'. Pdf-child tools surface as scholar.pdf.* proxies, never as raw pdf.*.

enforcement.gate: grep -rhoE 'name:\s*"[^"]*"' src/server/tools/ 2>/dev/null | grep -vE 'name:\s*"scholar\.' | grep -q . && exit 1 || exit 0

invariant.constraint: Foundation's migrations.ts invokes runRawDdl(db) after Drizzle migrate(). Cycle ordering depends on this: chunk_vec (6.5) and reading_queue view (6.6) materialize only after Drizzle tables exist.
